label: Johnson
header:
# Johnson municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 12; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Johnson's five selectboard members as Michael Dunham, Peter Hammond, Adrienne Parker, Eben Patch, and Paul Warden (Chair)

Town of Johnson, Certificate of Votes for Town and LNMUU District Officers, annual town meeting, March 3, 2026 (official town website): Michael Dunham (three-year term, 187 votes), Paul Warden (two-year term, 216), and Eben Patch (one-year term, 215) were elected at the March 3, 2026 meeting; Hammond and Parker hold over

Town of Johnson, 2025 Town Report (official town website), 'Town Officers - 2025' table: the pre-meeting board was Patch, Dunham, Hammond, Parker, and Duncan Hastings (resigned) with Warden sitting as an appointee; the 2026 election seated the five members above

Town of Johnson, Certificate of Votes for Town and LNMUU District Officers, annual town meeting, March 3, 2026 (official town website): Beth Foy was elected Town Moderator for a one-year term at the March 3, 2026 meeting (23 votes, from the floor); David Williams held the office in 2025 per the town report
Town of Johnson (official website), Town Clerk page: 'The Town Clerk is appointed by the Selectboard,' and the page names Susan Tinker as Town Clerk/Assistant Treasurer
Town of Johnson, Municipal Directory: 'Town Clerk's Office -- Susan Tinker, Town Clerk/Assistant Treasurer'

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Susan Tinker as Johnson's town clerk contact. The January 2026 Guide still lists Rosemary Audibert, who attested the March 4, 2026 certificate of votes as Town Clerk; Tinker succeeded her in spring 2026
Town of Johnson, Municipal Directory: Lydia Beach Putvain is 'Treasurer/Assistant Town Clerk'

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Lydia Beach Putvain as Johnson's town treasurer contact. The January 2026 Guide still lists Rosemary Audibert for both clerk and treasurer; she held both offices until spring 2026
Town of Johnson (official website), Library Board of Trustees page: the board is Kelly Vandorn (Chair), Jasmine Yuris (Vice-chair), Eric Schulz, Suzanne Dodge, and Trista Tallman

Town of Johnson, Certificate of Votes for Town and LNMUU District Officers, annual town meeting, March 3, 2026 (official town website): Trista Tallman (five-year term, 213 votes) and Eric Schulz (three-year term, 225) were elected library trustees at the March 3, 2026 meeting

Town of Johnson, 2025 Town Report (official town website), 'Town Officers - 2025' table: the pre-meeting board was Sabrina Rossi (term expired March 2026), Vandorn, Yuris, Schulz, and Dodge on staggered five-year terms

Town of Johnson, Certificate of Votes for Town and LNMUU District Officers, annual town meeting, March 3, 2026 (official town website): the delinquent tax collector contest at the March 3, 2026 meeting returned 'NO WINNER,' and Article 7 of the warning was adopted: 'Voted to have the Selectboard appoint a collector of delinquent taxes.' The appointee is not published, so the post is created without a membership
Town of Johnson, 2025 Town Report (official town website), 'Town Officers - 2025' table: Rosemary Audibert held the elected office ('Tax Collector') to March 2026

Town of Johnson, 2025 Town Report (official town website), 'Town Officers - 2025' table: the officers table seats a single 'Trustee of Public Money,' Rosemary Audibert; she left town office in spring 2026 and no official source publishes a successor, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Johnson, 2025 Town Report (official town website), 'Town Officers - 2025' table: the APPOINTMENTS section of the officers table names Dean Locke as First Constable, an appointment of the selectboard

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): names twelve justices of the peace for Johnson: Jennifer Burton, Michael Dunham, Jan Gearhart, Bari Gladstone, Martha Leonard, Randy Manning, Kyle Nuse, Eric Osgood, Shayne Spence, Margaret Warden, Jasmine Yuris, and Molly Zapp. The 2025 town report's Board of Civil Authority roster for the same term shares only seven of these names (and adds five others); the certified Secretary of State listing governs the slate, and the divergence is flagged on issue #163

Town of Johnson, 2025 Town Report (official town website), 'Town Officers - 2025' table: the Board of Civil Authority roster (term February 1, 2025 to January 31, 2027) names Janice Gearhart, Bari Gladstone, Margo Warden, Cynthia Hennard, Diane Lehouiller, Eric Osgood, Martha Leonard, Gary Underwood, Kyle Nuse, Jasmine Yuris, Helen McElroy, and Gregory Hill; Michael Dunham sits on the board ex officio as a selectboard member

jp_election.name: Johnson Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): names twelve winners for Johnson: Jennifer Burton, Michael Dunham, Jan Gearhart, Bari Gladstone, Martha Leonard, Randy Manning, Kyle Nuse, Eric Osgood, Shayne Spence, Margaret Warden, Jasmine Yuris, and Molly Zapp. Jennifer Burton of Johnson is a different person from Jennifer Burton of Jericho, who was also elected a justice of the peace in 2024; the office is town-bound
